originalTitle: Why the Market Dipped But KB Home (KBH) Gained Today
summary: KB Home (KBH) closed at $57.56 in the latest trading session, marking a +1.84% move from the prior day.
content:
In the latest close session, KB Home (KBH) was up +1.84% at $57.56. The stock outperformed the S&P 500, which registered a daily loss of 0.32%. At the same time, the Dow lost 0.34%, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq lost 0.6%.

Coming into today, shares of the homebuilder had gained 3.12% in the past month. In that same time, the Construction sector lost 1.42%, while the S&P 500 gained 2.46%.

The investment community will be paying close attention to the earnings performance of KB Home in its upcoming release. The company is forecasted to report an EPS of $0.88, showcasing a 45.34% downward movement from the corresponding quarter of the prior year. Meanwhile, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for revenue is projecting net sales of $1.29 billion, down 20.14% from the year-ago period.

For the full year, the Zacks Consensus Estimates are projecting earnings of $3.3 per share and revenue of $5.09 billion, which would represent changes of -49.39% and -18.37%, respectively, from the prior year.

Any recent changes to analyst estimates for KB Home should also be noted by investors. These revisions typically reflect the latest short-term business trends, which can change frequently. Hence, positive alterations in estimates signify analyst optimism regarding the business and profitability.

Our research demonstrates that these adjustments in estimates directly associate with imminent stock price performance. Investors can capitalize on this by using the Zacks Rank. This model considers these estimate changes and provides a simple, actionable rating system.

The Zacks Rank system, which varies between #1 (Strong Buy) and #5 (Strong Sell), carries an impressive track record of exceeding expectations, confirmed by external audits, with stocks at #1 delivering an average annual return of +25% since 1988. Over the past month, the Zacks Consensus EPS estimate has moved 0.22% higher. At present, KB Home boasts a Zacks Rank of #3 (Hold).

In the context of valuation, KB Home is at present trading with a Forward P/E ratio of 17.15. For comparison, its industry has an average Forward P/E of 14.47, which means KB Home is trading at a premium to the group.

Meanwhile, KBH's PEG ratio is currently 9.37. Comparable to the widely accepted P/E ratio, the PEG ratio also accounts for the company's projected earnings growth. By the end of yesterday's trading, the Building Products - Home Builders industry had an average PEG ratio of 2.87.

The Building Products - Home Builders industry is part of the Construction sector. With its current Zacks Industry Rank of 205, this industry ranks in the bottom 17% of all industries, numbering over 250.

The Zacks Industry Rank gauges the strength of our industry groups by measuring the average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups. Our research shows that the top 50% rated industries outperform the bottom half by a factor of 2 to 1.

Keep in mind to rely on Zacks.com to watch all these stock-impacting metrics, and more, in the succeeding trading sessions.

chineseTitle: 为什么市场下跌但 KB Home (KBH) 今天上涨
chineseSummary: KB Home (KBH) 在最近一个交易日收于 57.56 美元，较前一日上涨 1.84%。
chineseContent:
在最近的收盘交易中，KB Home (KBH) 上涨 1.84%，至 57.56 美元。该股表现优于标准普尔 500 指数，后者日跌幅为 0.32%。与此同时，道指下跌 0.34%，以科技股为主的纳斯达克指数下跌 0.6%。

截至今天，该住宅建筑商的股价在过去一个月上涨了 3.12%。与此同时，建筑业下跌 1.42%，而标准普尔 500 指数上涨 2.46%。

投资界将密切关注KB Home即将发布的盈利表现。该公司预计每股收益为 0.88 美元，较去年同期下降 45.34%。与此同时，Zacks 的收入共识预计净销售额为 12.9 亿美元，比去年同期下降 20.14%。

对于全年，Zacks 一致预期预计每股收益为 3.3 美元，收入为 50.9 亿美元，与上一年相比分别变化-49.39%和-18.37%。

投资者还应注意 KB Home 分析师预测的任何近期变化。这些修订通常反映最新的短期业务趋势，这些趋势可能经常变化。因此，预测的积极变化表明分析师对业务和盈利能力持乐观态度。

我们的研究表明，这些预估调整与即将到来的股价表现直接相关。投资者可以通过使用 Zacks Rank 来利用这一点。该模型考虑了这些估计变化并提供了一个简单、可操作的评级系统。

Zacks Rank 系统介于#1（强力买入）和#5（强力卖出）之间，具有超出预期的令人印象深刻的记录，经外部审计证实，自 1988 年以来，排名第一的股票的平均年回报率为 +25%。在过去的一个月里，Zacks 共识 EPS 估计上升了 0.22%。目前，KB Home 拥有 Zacks 排名第 3 位（持有）。

从估值来看，KB Home 目前的远期市盈率为 17.15。相比之下，该行业的平均远期市盈率为 14.47，这意味着 KB Home 的交易价格高于该集团。

与此同时，KBH的PEG比率目前为9.37。与广泛接受的市盈率相比，PEG 比率也反映了公司的预期盈利增长。截至昨天交易结束，建筑产品-住宅建筑商行业的平均 PEG 率为 2.87。

建筑产品 - 住宅建筑商行业是建筑行业的一部分。该行业目前的 Zacks 行业排名为 205，在所有行业中排名垫底 17%，数量超过 250 个。

Zacks 行业排名通过衡量行业组内个股的平均 Zacks 排名来衡量我们行业组的实力。我们的研究表明，排名前 50% 的行业的表现比排名后一半的行业高出 2 比 1。
